title: Automating eval design and hillclimbing with Claude
summary: A new playbook adds the `/claude-api build-eval` and `/claude-api hillclimb` commands to the claude-api skill for automating eval design. build-eval interviews you, samples inputs, and waits for approval before choosing a grader and baseline, while hillclimb splits train and test sets and keeps a patch only if both improve, which limits overfitting. In the support benchmark, cost per ticket fell about 80% (4.6c to 1c) and held-out accuracy rose from 78.6% to 90.5%, and the claude-api skill's eval pass rate rose from 66.1% to 87.9%.

title: Claude now works with Google Docs, Sheets, and Slides
summary: The Claude for Google Workspace add-on is in public beta on all paid plans, adding a Claude sidebar to Docs, Sheets, and Slides. Claude reads the open file and selection and edits directly, such as restyling, adding formulas or charts, or changing slides, in either 'Ask before edits' or 'Accept all edits' mode. New Docs, Sheets, and Slides connectors (beta) let Claude create and edit Google files while respecting sharing permissions, with connectors, skills, and enterprise controls kept inside the add-on.

title: How Comcast and Booz Allen use Claude Mythos to find exploit chains and secure their codebases
summary: This customer story describes how Comcast and Booz Allen used Claude Mythos-class models through Project Glasswing to find flaws that scanners missed. Comcast, with 258 systems and about 170M lines of code, found a critical auth flaw in a public-facing platform and fixed it before exploitation, while Booz Allen traced an unprotected key across two languages to expose a boot-time device weakness. One analyst reviewed 8 systems and 138 repos in 12 days, and Comcast says validating findings is now the bottleneck.

title: We're expanding the Claude Startups program to help founders build
summary: The Claude Startups program is expanding to more founders, with up to $7,000 in Claude products and credits, including a free year of Claude Team and a one-time $1,000 API credit. A new Claude Startup Stack offers discounts and credits up to $45,000 on partner tools for sales, design, and data engineering, alongside Applied AI office hours and help with Claude Marketplace listings. Eligible founders started their company within the last 5 years or were funded within the last 2.

title: Build live dashboards and animate explainers with Claude
summary: Anthropic introduced Claude Dashboards and Claude Motion, both in beta. Dashboards connect to BigQuery, Databricks, Snowflake, or Salesforce so users can ask plain-language questions and click any number to see its query (paid plans), while Motion turns a prompt into an editable-code animated explainer exportable to MP4 (Team and Enterprise). Docs, Slides, and Design leave beta and are available on every plan including Free, with the standalone Claude Design folding into Claude (the old URL works until Dec 14).

title: Claude Code in the cloud: a field guide to cloud sessions
summary: Cloud sessions run Claude Code on its own VM with the repo cloned to a fresh branch, and can be started from claude.ai/code, mobile, Desktop, the terminal (`claude --cloud "..."`), or Slack, included in Pro, Max, Team, and Enterprise. Sessions keep running if the laptop sleeps, isolate parallel tasks, and keep the GitHub token outside the VM so pushes only reach their own branch. They suit parallel backlog fixes and mobile starts, while shared plan usage, idle-VM reclaiming, and the need for a GitHub App on private repos are limits, and local sessions remain better for local DBs, VPNs, GPUs, and hardware.
